name: 42videobricks
description: Integrates the 42videobricks video ingest/transcoding/streaming service as a Drupal media source with an upload library.
project_description:
Integrate top-tier video capabilities into your business swiftly and effortlessly with 42videobricks. And thanks to this module, everything is now easier than ever.

 
 Convert your videos into the best format. 
 Store your video in a 100% GDPR compliant vault. 
 Deliver the video to your viewers throughout the world. 
 Grant you access to a 100% customisable web player. 
 
 42videobricks has been designed as a SaaS solution to manage the complexities of video streaming for you: no infrastructure setup is required, no CapEx, and no complexity! Simply add our embed code to your Drupal site or service to integrate video streaming, and it will work like a charm!

This module relies on the external service 42videobricks API for uploading your videos: https://api.42videobricks.com 

As well has an external service for streaming your uploaded videos from the 42videobricks service: https://stream.42videobricks.com 

This module integrates the external use of 42videobricks service in order to use it into your own Drupal project:

 
 More information about the external service 42videobricks can be found here: https://42videobricks.com/ 
 
 Terms of use: https://42videobricks.com/en/terms 
 Privacy Policy: https://42videobricks.com/en/privacypolicy 
 
 
 42videobricks streaming provides as well an administration where you can easily manage your videos: https://admin.42videobricks.com 

 Features 
 
 Upload your portrait or landscape videos (up to 4K) directly from your Drupal admin backoffice. They will be quickly encoded and ready for streaming. 
 Select previously uploaded videos from your 42videobricks library. 
 Embed videos with our responsive HTML5 player and Drupal media integration. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 You will have to navigate into admin/config/videobricks/settings and configure your API key and environment.

This module creates a media source "videobricks" which can easily be used on your ckeditor settings embed or on your fields integration.

For embed your videos into media, you will have to add the Video Id from the library page and save it.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module uses Drupal Media for integrating the videos into your Drupal project.

It has a dedicated source type media "videobricks" which can be enabled on your ckeditor or it can be added on your fields.
